# Landing page design references

Curated landing pages Elena keeps as design references. Each entry links to a subpage with live screenshots and captions.

Site: https://elenacabrera.xyz
Collections: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections?type=landing

## Superlogical
- URL: https://superlogical.com/
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/superlogical
- Tags: devtools, productivity, ai
- Design focus: Ultra-minimal devtool landing that sells a technical vision through long-form editorial copy and a single bold gradient visual anchor instead of product UI chrome.
- Screenshots:
  - Split hero with gradient: Left-aligned headline and layered keyword stack sit opposite a tall rounded gradient block, establishing a typographic-first hero with almost no chrome.
  - Three-step product vision: A manifesto section lays out a numbered three-part plan beside the same gradient motif, using restrained hierarchy and generous whitespace to sell a technical vision.
  - Founder pedigree grid: Team bios with headshots and heavyweight prior-company credentials create authority through pedigree rather than logos or metrics.
  - Investor list and waitlist: Named investor columns and a minimal underline-style email capture close the page, using social proof density plus a low-friction beta signup.

## Typo
- URL: https://www.typo.so/
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/typo
- Tags: productivity, ai
- Design focus: Soft, cloud-themed consumer SaaS landing that uses floating modular cards and bento layouts to show a flexible workspace product.
- Screenshots:
  - Username claim hero: A sky-background hero centers a username claim field while orbiting content cards preview integrations like Spotify and audio, selling modularity through scattered UI tiles.
  - Product canvas preview: A large rounded product mockup demonstrates the bento workspace layout with profile blocks, media widgets, and folder navigation under a concise value headline.
  - Persona icon columns: Four equal columns with 3D icons segment the audience into Creator, Builder, Artist, and Brand, using playful illustration to broaden appeal.
  - Orbital feature hub: A radial layout places the brand at the center with orbiting capability icons for AI, storage, shop, and blogging, visualizing an all-in-one platform.
  - Quote testimonial row: Minimal bordered cards in a horizontal row carry short user quotes with lots of negative space, keeping social proof light and airy.
  - Privacy and share features: A split grid pairs short feature copy with simple UI controls like a public/private toggle and circular share menu to explain publishing workflows.
  - Community closing CTA: A centered headline and pill button are ringed by user avatars, using circular social proof to reinforce a personal, community-driven product.

## EliseAI
- URL: https://eliseai.com/healthai
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/eliseai
- Tags: ai, health, enterprise
- Design focus: Enterprise healthcare AI landing that combines bold gradient heroes, compliance badges, and proof-heavy mid-page sections.
- Screenshots:
  - Healthcare demo hero: A blue gradient hero pairs a demo-booking form with HIPAA and G2 trust marks and a floating scheduling card mockup showing VoiceAI output.
  - Customer video carousel: A centered headline introduces a horizontal video testimonial carousel with client logos overlaid on thumbnails, prioritizing founder/operator proof.
  - VoiceAI product split: A dark split section contrasts copy and CTA on the left with a phone mockup on the right, then transitions into a white feature headline block below.
  - Specialty coverage grid: A 2x2 grid maps healthcare specialties to photo-backed cards with Learn More links, tailoring the product to vertical use cases.
  - Benefits and integrations: A dark three-column icon grid quantifies operational benefits before a white integrations section cites EHR compatibility and SOC 2/HIPAA compliance.
  - Competitive comparison table: A highlighted EliseAI column with checkmarks versus gray competitor columns uses a classic us-vs-them table to communicate feature superiority.
  - Resource links and FAQ: Three case-study link columns sit above a large FAQ accordion, handling late-funnel objections with expandable technical questions.

## Visitors
- URL: https://visitors.now/
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/visitors
- Tags: analytics
- Design focus: Polished indie-analytics SaaS page with floating nav, lavender gradients, and product-led hero previews.
- Screenshots:
  - Dashboard hero preview: A centered headline and dual CTAs sit above a logo strip and tabbed dashboard mockup embedded in a soft purple gradient, showing the product immediately.
  - Color-coded feature bento: A 2x2 card grid uses distinct accent colors and mini charts or globe visuals to explain revenue attribution, realtime tracking, profiles, and performance metrics.
  - Competitor comparison table: A highlighted Visitors column compares GDPR, revenue, and journey features against GA, Plausible, and Fathom in a clean matrix layout.
  - Usage-based pricing: A split pricing card combines a monthly/yearly toggle, event slider, and included-features checklist with a simulated globe visualization on the right.
  - FAQ accordion: A minimalist accordion addresses privacy, limits, and Google Analytics comparisons, with one expanded answer explaining no-cookie compliance.

## Kapia

- Tags: ai, enterprise, productivity

## Midday
- URL: https://midday.ai/
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/midday
- Tags: fintech, invoicing, productivity
- Design focus: Clean fintech/productivity landing with serif hero typography, step-based product walkthroughs, and structured case-study social proof.
- Screenshots:
  - Serif hero with acquisition badge: A centered serif headline and single black CTA sit beneath a pill announcement badge, with faint integration logos providing quiet credibility before a dark product preview band.
  - How it works stepper: A vertical step list on the left highlights the active workflow stage while a crisp transaction table mockup on the right demonstrates unified banking data.
  - Feature grid headline: A centered section title introduces the full product surface area— invoicing, transactions, time tracking— before a bento-style capability grid below.
  - Invoicing feature card: Large rounded cards pair short benefit copy with embedded invoice UI previews, using alternating layouts to walk through core finance workflows.
  - Accounting time-savings proof: A bold 4–6 hours savings callout anchors a section about accounting readiness, quantifying operational benefit with oversized numerals instead of testimonial quotes.
  - Built with users band: A community-forward section uses avatar stacks and short founder quotes to show the product is shaped alongside real operators, not shipped in isolation.
  - Footer navigation close: A multi-column footer with Features, Product, Company, and Resources links closes the page with information density and minimal visual noise.

## Arche
- URL: https://thearcheproject.com/
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/arche
- Tags: ai, devtools, productivity
- Design focus: Warm, editorial open-source AI landing that combines serif headlines, retro photography, and crisp product diagrams.
- Screenshots:
  - Gradient hero with install: A centered serif headline with textured orange emphasis words sits above Mac download and curl-install commands on a peach-to-cream radial gradient.
  - Retro problem cards: Three tall cards use grainy vintage photos and short pain-point labels like the glue and the silos before a bold mission statement about irreplaceable decisions.
  - One harness diagram: An alternating text-and-diagram section shows fragmented copy-paste between Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and Notion flowing into a single Arche harness.
  - Integrations library grid: A dense 4-column connector grid lists major SaaS tools with one-line capability descriptions, signaling breadth through recognizable logos and uniform cards.
  - Open-source mission: A centered manifesto section with a highlighted needs to exist headline and three bordered principle cards explains why the project is public and self-hostable.
  - FAQ accordion: A warm-background FAQ uses serif heading typography and simple plus icons in a spacious vertical list aimed at differentiation from ChatGPT and Notion.
  - Final action CTA: A gradient footer block pairs a pixel-styled Death to busywork headline with See it in action and Self-host now buttons for dual conversion paths.

## ngrok
- URL: https://ngrok.com/
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/ngrok
- Tags: devtools, ai, enterprise
- Design focus: Dark, premium devinfra landing that mixes serif hero typography, rainbow accents, and CLI-first onboarding.
- Screenshots:
  - Gradient serif hero: A black hero uses rainbow-gradient headline text, a glowing free-start CTA, enterprise logo strip, and the start of a two-product cards section below.
  - Dual gateway products: Side-by-side yellow and green cards use simplified system diagrams to compare AI Gateway model routing against general Gateway security and traffic routing.
  - CLI quickstart and quotes: A grid-framed brew install command and platform icons lead into a horizontal row of short developer tweet-style testimonials.
  - Testimonial wall: A masonry grid of dark quote cards from engineers and directors at known companies creates high-volume social proof before a security headline.
  - Compliance and closing CTA: A two-row compliance checklist with green checks transitions into a glowing aura-backed final CTA with free start and pricing buttons.
  - Footer product links: A structured dark footer organizes product, solutions, and docs links beneath the closing conversion band, keeping navigation scannable at page end.

## Ramp
- URL: https://ramp.com/
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/ramp
- Tags: fintech, ai, enterprise
- Design focus: Enterprise fintech landing with lime accent CTAs, live product UI in the hero, and data-visualization sections that turn complex finance workflows into scannable proof.
- Screenshots:
  - AI spend dashboard hero: A split hero pairs a bold savings headline with a detailed token-spend dashboard mockup— line chart, KPI tiles, and model breakdown bars— on a subtle dot-grid background.
  - Efficiency comparison chart: A stippled bar chart card visualizes cost-per-token differences between efficient and inefficient teams beside explanatory copy and a See how you compare link.
  - Savings stats and testimonials: Oversized percentage stats in dark cards lead into a three-column testimonial row from finance leaders, mixing quantitative proof with operator quotes.
  - Weekly briefing feature: An alternating layout places a briefing UI mockup opposite copy about translating tokens into explainable dollars, showing product depth through realistic dashboard chrome.
  - Ramp Router API: A minimal gray product card with task prompts and a loading indicator supports a concise API value prop about cutting inference costs through one endpoint.
  - FAQ and closing CTA: A ruled FAQ accordion addresses AI spend objections before a repeated email-capture CTA closes the page with the core Time is money headline.
  - Logo strip social proof: A horizontal logo marquee of ambitious companies reinforces scale claims above late-page feature sections, using grayscale marks for understated credibility.

## Aside
- URL: https://aside.com/
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/aside
- Tags: ai, browser, productivity
- Design focus: Apple-clean AI browser landing that leads with product UI, benchmark proof, and security feature grids.
- Screenshots:
  - Browser product hero: A cloud-sky hero centers a full browser mockup with agent tabs, Ask AI search, model picker, and recent tasks beneath a YC badge and download CTA.
  - Use-case card trio: Three pastel-backed cards show login, messaging, and spreadsheet workflows with prompt labels above UI snippets, explaining agent capability through scenarios.
  - Benchmark bar chart: A horizontal bar chart highlights Aside at 99% against Browser Use, GPT, Claude, and ChatGPT Atlas, using data visualization as competitive social proof.
  - Agent password manager: A feature hero uses masked-password wordplay in the headline and three UI vignettes to explain autofill for agents without exposing credentials to AI.
  - Privacy four-column grid: Four equal columns with small UI illustrations cover local processing, encryption, sandbox permissions, and bring-your-own-model subscriptions.
  - Gradient closing CTA: A soft blue dotted-gradient banner carries a final human-and-agent headline and download button above a structured multi-column footer.

  - Calendar sync widget: A macOS menu-bar style widget mockup shows one-click Join & take notes above a calendar event, selling OS-level integration through realistic chrome.

## anyformat
- URL: https://www.anyformat.ai/es
- Subpage: https://elenacabrera.xyz/collections/landings/anyformat
- Tags: ai, enterprise
- Design focus: Enterprise document-AI landing that pairs bilingual product storytelling with composable workflow tabs, benchmark tables against frontier models, and trust signals around EU residency.
- Screenshots:
  - Split document-AI hero: A left-aligned Spanish headline and dual CTAs sit beside a 3D isometric document-on-platform illustration, selling parse-extract-validate workflows with EU residency and ISO 27001 callouts.
  - Composable workflow tabs: A pill tab bar for Parsear / Extraer / Clasificar / Dividir / Validar / Orquestar drives a split feature block with a scanning-document visual and stacked capability cards for structured markdown output.
  - Parser benchmark table: A comparison table ranks anyformat against Claude, GPT, Azure DI, and Textract on parse score and cost-per-page, then transitions into a Made for production not demos section header.
  - SDK and agent skill install: A dark terminal mockup of Claude Code building an extract workflow sits beside TypeScript/Python SDK, CLI, and Agent Skill install cards for a developer-first integration story.
  - Mode toggle and annie loop: Two product cards show Fast/Standard/Agentic mode switching with a waveform graphic and an annie optimization chart that lifts precision across iterations.
  - Security and industry tabs: A dark EU-residency security band leads into a light industry tab strip—AP, logistics, finance, healthcare—with an invoice illustration for accounts-payable use cases.
  - FAQ accordion: A spacious Preguntas Frecuentes list expands the first answer defining anyformat as document intelligence for enterprise teams, covering IDP, OCR, and LLM differentiation.
  - Dark closing CTA: A high-contrast black rounded panel pairs Empieza por tus documentos más difíciles with free-start and demo buttons plus a metallic chameleon mark, closing on no-card free credits.
